summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release with a September 2026 commercial update and details of a routine monthly cash distribution. The Board approved a distribution of US$0.28 per share from Contributed Surplus, with record date October 19, 2026 and payment on or about October 27, 2026, plus Euronext VPS and NYSE ex-date mechanics. September TCE earnings averaged about US$65,800 per day gross across twelve vessels. This is an ordinary operating and distribution update, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are present. Watch distribution sustainability versus charter rates.
